Bone.Manipulation.title: Bone Manipulation
Bone.Manipulation.description: You have obtained the power to manipulation and control your bones

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{marrow:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Bone Manipulation","color":"white","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}

Secondary.Ability.title: Bone Bullets
Secondary.Ability.description: Shoot sharp bones from your hands. §dBattlemode §fmust be enabled via keybind. §dRight Click §fto use this ability

commands: execute if score @s Bone.Amount matches ..0 run scoreboard players set @s Bone.Amount 0

Transform.Unlock.title: Bone Protrusion
Transform.Unlock.description: Manipulate the bones in your body to form sharp spikes

first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run playsound eop:diamond_transform master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run playsound eop:claw master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
last_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run playsound eop:diamond_transform master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run playsound eop:claw master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2

Bone.Weapons.Unlock.title: Bone Weapons
Bone.Weapons.Unlock.description: Create a sword and shield made of bone

Spikes.Unlock.title: Bone Spikes
Spikes.Unlock.description: Send a wave of pointy bones in the direction you are facing

Spikes.title: Bone Spikes
first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run playsound eop:diamond_transform master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run playsound eop:claw master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 1
commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run scoreboard players set @e[type=armor_stand,limit=20,distance=..20] EOP.Bone.Type 0
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run scoreboard players set @e[type=armor_stand,limit=20,distance=..20] EOP.Bone.Type 1

Healing.Unlock.title: Marrow Regeneration
Healing.Unlock.description: Harness the regenerative properties of your own bone structure to heal injuries

commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run playsound minecraft:entity.skeleton.death master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run playsound minecraft:entity.iron_golem.hurt master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
